newsitem.title: UK: Police escape injury in N.Ireland bomb attack.
newsitem.headline: Police escape injury in N.Ireland bomb attack.

text.p: A police patrol in Northern Ireland escaped injury in a bomb attack on Tuesday, police said.
An explosion occurred in the Shantallow area of the province's second city of Londonderry as a two-vehicle police patrol was passing, a police spokesman said.
The police spokesman said it was not immediately clear if a bomb had exploded at the side of the road or whether it had been fired at the patrol.

The incident came as police in Northern Ireland questioned two men over an Irish Republican Army rocket attack on the High Court in Belfast on Monday, which raised fears of retaliation by pro-British "Loyalist" guerrillas.
After Monday's attack by the IRA, which is fighting to end British rule in Northern Ireland, security forces were on heightened alert for further violence.

Sinn Fein, the IRA's political wing, is pressing for inclusion in multi-party peace talks, but British Prime Minister John Major said the rocket attack on the courthouse made it difficult to see how this could be achieved.
